name: CK-Arena
description: CK-Arena is a game-based multi-agent interaction benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' conceptual knowledge and reasoning abilities in dynamic, interactive settings. It challenges models to describe, differentiate, and infer conceptual boundaries through gameplay, simulating real-world conceptual reasoning.
reputation: A niche but interesting benchmark used in recent conceptual reasoning work, with limited but growing attention in the LLM evaluation community.
notes: Built upon the Undercover game; evaluates conceptual boundaries and reasoning in interactive multi-agent settings.
